pricing.assumption: Cold paid-equivalent estimate; input-cache discounts and free-plan billing excluded.

definitions.action_accuracy: Exact tool-name/multiplicity or clarify/decline/reply label; no LLM judge.
definitions.text_actions: Frozen lexical rules; plain replies following tool results count as reply. Text correctness is not judged.
definitions.argument_exact_match: Joint exact normalized arguments on every gold tool turn; missing/wrong tool is incorrect.
definitions.normalization: Schema defaults/nulls normalized; modifier/item/call order ignored; duplicates, quantities and bindings preserved.
definitions.field_f1: Micro multiset F1, aligned by tool and item-name occurrence; includes item/size/quantity/modifiers plus IDs/category/customer name.
definitions.valid_tool_call_rate: Schema-valid parsed tool responses / all attempted tool responses, including malformed and provider-rejected attempts.
definitions.end_to_end_success: Final backend state equals gold and the agent terminates without an execution/protocol error.
definitions.action_and_state_success: Additionally requires correct first action/arguments at every user turn and no missing/extra tool calls.
definitions.state_equality: Line/modifier ordering ignored; all orders, IDs, prices, quantities, customer names, statuses and logical times retained.
definitions.latency: Uncached request wall time including network/retries; deliberate quota pacing and local cache hits excluded. Not S5 CPU latency.
definitions.cost: Cold paid-equivalent cost, not an actual bill. Missing provider-error usage is excluded; see usage_coverage.
definitions.confidence_intervals: Conversation-cluster percentile bootstrap on complete independent_test only. Undefined resample metrics omitted; undefined point metrics are null.
definitions.coverage: Independent cases are Claude-authored with Codex gold and weighted toward declines; not human-written evidence.
